SELECT
da.company_name,
da.account_id,
SUM(fr.amount_eur) AS total_paid_eur
FROM fct_revenue_daily fr
JOIN dim_accounts da USING (account_id)
WHERE fr.revenue_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY da.account_id, da.company_name
ORDER BY total_paid_eur DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_invoiced_accounts FROM dim_accounts da WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fct_invoices fi WHERE fi.account_id = da.account_id);

SELECT a.company_name, a.account_id, SUM(GREATEST(i.amount_eur - i.paid_amount_eur, 0)) AS overdue_amount_eur
FROM fct_invoices i
JOIN dim_accounts a USING (account_id)
WHERE i.status <> 'void'
  AND NOT i.is_fully_paid
  AND i.days_outstanding > 0
GROUP BY a.company_name, a.account_id
ORDER BY overdue_amount_eur DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(i.amount_eur), 0) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS total_invoiced_eur FROM fct_invoices i JOIN dim_accounts a ON i.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.status <> 'void';

SELECT date_trunc('quarter', issued_at)::DATE AS quarter_start, SUM(amount_eur) AS total_invoiced_eur
FROM fct_invoices
WHERE status <> 'void'
  AND issued_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND issued_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY quarter_start
ORDER BY quarter_start;

SELECT
  DATE '2026-04-01' AS quarter_start,
  DATE '2026-06-30' AS quarter_end,
  SUM(amount_eur) AS revenue_eur,
  SUM(payment_count) AS payment_count
FROM fct_revenue_daily
WHERE revenue_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30';

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', revenue_date)::DATE AS month_start,
    SUM(amount_eur) AS collected_eur,
    SUM(payment_count) AS payment_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FILTER (WHERE amount_eur > 0) AS paying_accounts
  FROM fct_revenue_daily
  WHERE revenue_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  month_start,
  collected_eur,
  payment_count,
  paying_accounts,
  SUM(collected_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_collected_eur,
  CASE WHEN payment_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE collected_eur / payment_count END AS avg_payment_eur
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_start;
